lines.t: I was bound, now I'm free
All glory to the King of Kings
Come on, come on, let's praise him
I used to walk in shadow, hearing only my pain
Chasing after whispers that led me to the rain
But then your truth came shining, cutting through the lie
Now I'm dancing in your mercy, got my eyes on high
It's the word that heals, it's the fire that saves
It's the spirit of power that rolls the stone away
Now I lift my hands up, praise you, Lord
You broke my chains and opened every door
Every door
Now I'm walking in the light
And there's freedom in my soul
You spoke the word of truth
And made me whole, whole, whole
The trumpets of heaven
Yeah, they call my name
Every step is guided
By the lamb who was slain
No more fear, no more shame inside
I'm clothed in truth
With glory as my guide
It's the voice of love
It's the sound of grace
Cause the children home to the holy place
Now I lift my hands up
Praise you, Lord
Praise you, Lord
You broke my chains and opened every door
Every door
Now I'm walking in the light
And there's freedom in my soul
You spoke a word of truth
When the world says no, you whisper come
When my strength ran out, you were the one
Now my heart beats loud with heaven's sound
Your volumes of truth, they turn me around
I'm free, free in the name
Lift him up, proclaim his reign
Spirit fire, burning bright
I'm living in the truth
Walking in life
Now I lift my hands up
Praise you, Lord
Praise you, Lord
You broke my chains and opened every door
Every door
Now I'm walking in the light
And there's freedom in my soul
You spoke the word of truth
And made me whole
I'm alive in the truth that reigns
Praise you, Lord
Oh, oh, oh, praise you, Lord All glory to the kingdom shore
